verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents case data retrieval through list and fetch APIs intended for data syncing. It also offers one-click case exports, a Reports History export of case data with comments, and CSV downloads from analytics tables. Together these cover case export, but not the full multi-entity reconciliation story. missing for 10: documented export of customer/CRM data, alert data and decision/disposition data; any documentation of stable identifiers in exports or API responses; a published API reference or schema (the OpenAPI probes returned 404); independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can export customer, alert, case and decision data with stable identifiers for reconciliation

citations.quote: for information retrieval or data syncing, Hummingbird provides APIs for listing cases and fetching case information over API.
Download case information: This feature allows you to export detailed case information with one-click.
This will download case data for the time frame selected, including case comments.
You can export data from a table you need by clicking on the Download icon in the upper right of each table. This initiates a CSV download.
